---
name: Team Task Assignment
about: Assign a specific development sprint task to a team member
title: "[TASK] <Task Title>"
labels: task
assignees: ''
---

### Task Description
Detailed explanation of the task to be completed.

### Owner
- [ ] Member 1 (`feature/auth`)
- [ ] Member 2 (`feature/user`)
- [ ] Member 3 (`feature/product`)
- [ ] Member 4 (`feature/frontend`)

### Target Branch
- `dev` (via Pull Request from member's `feature/*` branch)

### Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Code strictly confined to member's designated files.
- [ ] Feature tested locally.
- [ ] Pull request submitted against `dev` with peer review.
